judge.quote: during such period the condominium will effectively be managed by the Sponsor, which will control the board
judge.why: P4 and P13 say the Board manages the condominium during sponsor control, with no outside agent and no fee. P13 adds that this effectively means the Sponsor, and that the Board may later self-manage or hire an agent. B matches this. A names the effective party but leaves out that the Board is the formal manager. C matches 'no outside agent' but leaves out that the Board/Sponsor manages and that a later agent is possible.
